selected_status.summary: August 21 dated operator release explicitly describes STT Tokyo 1 as a data center it operates and describes continuing operations since service commencement. This confirms existing operation as of publication; it does not date the original opening, completion or certification grant and does not assert full capacity utilization.

selected_locator.precision: Google Maps selected place point for STT Tokyo 1, used as a labelled property locator for the STT Tokyo Inzai Campus within Goodman Business Park. It does not establish a surveyed building or campus boundary, entrance, individual data hall or exact Tokyo 2 location.

The operator release and currently linked Tokyo 1 factsheet establish the same facility name, Inzai location, Goodman Business Park host and first building of the two-building STT campus. The factsheet lists 2-2-5 Kaguro-Minami; the independent CASBEE Stage 7 certificate includes that exact address. Root separately observed the matching operator website, Kaguro-Minami address and plus code in the browser; those fields are not represented as present in the hashed HTTP body. No excluded directory coordinate or unnamed building containment supplies selected identity or geometry.
selected_locator.uncertainty_reason: Google Maps supplies no measured horizontal accuracy for the selected place. Decimal places are retained from its selected-object record and do not imply survey precision or known offsets to operating data halls.

acceptance_reason: The dated operator release confirms continuing operation of Tokyo 1 within the STT campus. The operator-linked factsheet supplies the facility name and exact address, and an independent historical CASBEE certificate confirms the Stage 7 address bridge. The Google Maps original response explicitly ties the exact selected facility name to its selected-place point. The labelled property marker is limited to the STT campus; the larger Goodman Business Park is not merged.
scope_limits: Tokyo 1 and Tokyo 2 are buildings in the same operator-defined STT Inzai campus. Future Tokyo 2 project evidence must attach to this physical site key if that identity remains supported; a separate directory or map identifier is not grounds for another physical site. No current Tokyo 2 operating status, construction event or capacity is selected. The whole Goodman Business Park is a larger host property containing other operators and is not merged into this site.
